Welcome to your DC Metro Map

Let's get it on your Wi-Fi. This takes about a minute.

1Wi-Fi network

Looking for networks...
The map uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; 5 GHz-only networks will not show up. Networks that need a sign-in page (hotels) are not supported.

2Name on your network

After setup, open the map at http://metromap.local (letters, numbers and dashes). Some older Android phones don't support .local names; use the IP address shown at the end instead.

3Time zone

The map sets its clock from the internet once it is online (and from its clock chip when offline).

4Trains

Where live train positions come from; the WMATA address is filled in. The API key is added automatically.
Live train positions need a free key from WMATA's developer site (developer.wmata.com, "Default Tier").
The map runs from a built-in timetable. No internet or key needed; you can switch to live trains later.
Advanced: standalone network (access point mode)
In access point mode the map runs its own standalone network, WLED-AP; it does this when it has no Wi-Fi, which is how you reached this page.
At least 8 characters. Leave empty to keep the current one.
Keep the standalone network always on
Normally it only opens when the map can't reach your Wi-Fi. Always on lets you reach the map directly at 4.3.2.1 at any time.
Go directly to the controls
Skips setup; nothing is saved. Without Wi-Fi the map stays in access point mode, and you can come back here at /setup.
